title: Front door health names the cloud environment
description:
As a caller targeting a named cloud environment, I want GET /health to name that environment, so I can tell development from staging without inferring it from the URL.

Feature: Channels and the message store

Scenario: The front door names its cloud environment
  Given a front door serving named environment "development" with HTTP
  Then GET /health reports environment "development"

Live exercise on development prints health_environment=1 after ThinTurn-only deploy. Staging and production exercise must still pass without this field until those stacks are redeployed (do not redeploy them here).

Not included: demo CLI, staging/production CDK, merge to main.
